scope: 23 participants in the 2026 official standings through Baku; pool-only F2 history remains intact
method: Editorial absolute ability, current results balanced with career and cross-category records. Detailed axis differences retained as unmeasured SIM priors. Not a points-to-rating formula.

drivers.name: Rafael Câmara
drivers.reason: 2025 F3 champion and current F2 leader; retain leading prospect rating.

drivers.name: Nikola Tsolov
drivers.reason: 2025 F3 runner-up and current F2 title contender; retain.

drivers.name: Alexander Dunne
drivers.reason: 2025 F2 fifth and current title contender; retain.

drivers.name: Gabriele Minì
drivers.reason: 2024 F3 runner-up, 2025 F2 thirteenth and strong 2026 recovery; retain.

drivers.name: Dino Beganovic
drivers.reason: 2025 F2 seventh and current fifth with recent Feature Race win; small upward revision.

drivers.name: Noel León
drivers.reason: Strong 2026 rookie season balanced against 2025 F3 seventeenth; modestly below the more established leading group.

drivers.name: Martinius Stenshorne
drivers.reason: 2025 F3 fifth and 2026 F2 seventh with a Feature Race win; small upward revision.

drivers.name: Joshua Dürksen
drivers.reason: 2024/2025 F2 tenth/ninth and 2026 eighth; retain experienced upper-midfield prior.

drivers.name: Kush Maini
drivers.reason: 2025 F2 sixteenth and current ninth; retain with improvement balanced against previous seasons.

drivers.name: Laurens van Hoepen
drivers.reason: 2025 F3 twelfth and current F2 tenth as a full-season rookie; small upward revision.

drivers.name: Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak
drivers.reason: 2025 F3 seventh and current F2 eleventh; retain.

drivers.name: Ritomo Miyata
drivers.reason: 2024/2025 F2 nineteenth/seventeenth and current twelfth support modest correction; retain substantial weight for 2023 SF and GT500 titles.

drivers.name: Rafael Villagómez
drivers.reason: 2025 F2 fourteenth and current thirteenth; retain.

drivers.name: John Bennett
drivers.reason: 2025 F2 twenty-second to current fourteenth, with prior GB3 runner-up record; small upward revision.

drivers.name: Oliver Goethe
drivers.reason: 2025 and current F2 fifteenth; modest downward correction while retaining F3/Euroformula achievements.

drivers.name: Roman Bilinski
drivers.reason: 2025 F3 eleventh and current F2 sixteenth as a rookie; modest upward correction to align the shared midfield range.

drivers.name: Sebastian Montoya
drivers.reason: Current seventeenth weighed alongside 2025 F2 twelfth; retain rather than map points directly to ability.

drivers.name: Emerson Fittipaldi Jr.
drivers.reason: Current eighteenth and 2025 Eurocup-3 eleventh support modest correction; this is Emerson, not historical Enzo Fittipaldi.

drivers.name: Colton Herta
drivers.reason: F2 adaptation has been difficult, but 2024 IndyCar runner-up and 2025 sixth support retaining shared absolute ability; missed Madrid races do not establish pace.

drivers.name: Mari Boya
drivers.reason: Difficult F2 rookie season balanced against 2025 F3 third; retain rather than a large current-points downgrade.

drivers.name: Nicolás Varrone
drivers.reason: F2 single-seater adaptation is weak; retain endurance-weighted shared prior supported by 2023 WEC LMGTE Am title and Le Mans class win. Category adaptation is not separately fitted.

drivers.name: Cian Shields
drivers.reason: 2025 F2 twenty-fourth and current twenty-second support retaining lower shared prior; avoid treating one points finish as a measured skill axis.

drivers.name: Hiyu Yamakoshi
drivers.reason: 2026 F3 ninth and only a Baku F2 debut sample; retain and do not punish limited starts.
